requirements.requirement: The system must render a phase label (e.g., Phase I, II, III, IV) within the MessageBubble scorecard UI when phase data is present.
The system must display the plain-language explanation corresponding to the phase directly beneath or adjacent to the phase label.
The system must display the phase score contribution value as part of the scorecard UI.
The system must visually group the phase label, explanation, and score contribution as a single measure within the MessageBubble.
The system must render phase information using the structured data contract defined in EVAL-CT-PHASE-UX-S1.
The system must correctly render all supported phase values (I, II, III, IV) without formatting errors.
The system must preserve consistency with existing MessageBubble styling and layout conventions.
The system must render phase content in a markdown-compatible format supported by MessageBubble.tsx.
The system must position the phase measure in a deterministic order relative to other scorecard measures.
The system must ensure the phase score contribution is numerically aligned with the overall score representation.
The system must not render the phase section if no phase data is provided by the upstream logic.
The system must display a fallback text indicating 'Phase not available' if the phase field is null but the measure is expected.
The system must sanitize and safely render all phase-related text to prevent UI rendering or injection issues.
The system must ensure that long explanation text wraps correctly within the MessageBubble without overflow or layout breakage.
The system must render the phase measure within 100ms of MessageBubble render time under normal conditions.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text from S2 is displayed exactly as provided without truncation.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text is human-readable and contains no raw codes or backend identifiers.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text corresponds semantically to the displayed phase label.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text avoids medical jargon beyond a consumer-friendly level.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text length is between 1 and 3 sentences.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text does not contain conflicting statements about trial safety or effectiveness.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text is deterministic for the same phase input within a session.
The system must ensure the LLM-generated explanation text does not include disclaimers unrelated to phase meaning.
The system must handle an unexpected phase value by rendering a generic explanation and not breaking the UI.
The system must handle missing explanation text from S2 by rendering a default explanation tied to the phase label.
